title: Reduce WebView validation prose clutter
summary: Converted the Home Pipeline Overview cross-page context from a visible multiline prose block into compact status tiles, hid its raw context summary behind a details disclosure, added the shared mediaPipelineDom review tile renderer, and added a browser-backed screenshot/clutter smoke that captures every requested page/subtab state plus compact viewport checks.
reason: Visible validation/evidence prose was competing with operational status. Vital counts and next-action information should scan as tiles, while explanatory or copy-oriented detail should stay available without occupying the default workbench surface.
behavior_before: The Home Pipeline Overview surfaced queue, completed-output, pending-publish, diagnostic, and next-step context as a visible multiline prose block. Evidence panels could also expose direct prose/callout blocks without an explicit visual keep reason.
behavior_after: The Home Pipeline Overview shows Queue, Completed, Pending Publish, Diagnostics, and Next Step review tiles, while the raw context is collapsed under Detailed context. Direct evidence prose/callout blocks without an allowed visual reason are hidden by default, and the new screenshot smoke records visible clutter offenders, overflow, screenshots, and missing requested subtabs in a manifest.

rollback_plan: Revert the review tile helper/export additions, restore the Home Pipeline Overview raw pre block to the default visible surface, remove the evidence prose hiding CSS rules, and remove the visual clutter screenshot smoke wrapper/test.
notes: Frontend-only change. No backend API, route, media policy, queue, publish, rename, settings-save, or filesystem mutation behavior was changed.
